## Start here

POST one lead as JSON to `/webhook/lead-agent`.

This sample has no webhook authentication. Add Header Auth before you expose it.

`CLAUDE_MODE=mock` and `CRM_MODE=stub` are the defaults, so the demo runs with no API keys. Set `live` and `hubspot` when you are ready to call those APIs.

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Production URL ends in /webhook/lead-agent. The test URL is only active while you listen in the editor.

nodes.name: Deduplicate
nodes.notes: Stores completed leads in workflow static data, keyed by email. Swap this node for an n8n Data table or a Google Sheet when you leave the demo.

nodes.name: Claude attempt 1
nodes.notes: Placeholder credential only. Create a Header Auth credential with name x-api-key and your Anthropic key, then select it here. This node does not run when CLAUDE_MODE is mock.

nodes.name: Mock attempt 1
nodes.notes: Demo mode. Sample emails return pinned qualifications so the walkthrough matches samples/outputs. Any other email uses the heuristic in scripts/lib/qualify.mjs. Live mode does not use this node.

nodes.name: Claude attempt 2
nodes.notes: Placeholder credential only. Create a Header Auth credential with name x-api-key and your Anthropic key, then select it here. This node does not run when CLAUDE_MODE is mock.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: $input.first().json }];

nodes.name: Upsert HubSpot contact
nodes.notes: Placeholder app token. Reached only when CRM_MODE=hubspot. No HubSpot account: keep the CRM stub, or replace this node with Google Sheets Append (email, name, company, score, tier, summary, suggestedFirstLine).

nodes.name: CRM stub
nodes.notes: Default CRM. Writes a stable stub id into the webhook response and the local store. A sheet row with the same fields is the documented swap.

nodes.name: Notify Slack
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. Enable after you attach a Slack access token and confirm the channel. Swap this node for Gmail or Send Email if you would rather be emailed.

parameters.content:
## Deduplicate

Workflow static data, one row per email, on this n8n instance only.

Swap for a Data table named `leads` (Row, If row exists, match email) or a Google Sheet lookup.

Header `x-reset-store: true` clears the store only while Claude mode is mock.

## Claude

Live mode calls the Messages API. The model id comes from `CLAUDE_MODEL` (default `claude-sonnet-5-5`).

The system prompt and ICP are copied from `prompts/` when you run `node scripts/build-workflow.mjs`.

JSON is validated against the ICP thresholds. One retry, then a 422 response. Website failures still continue, with empty text.

## Route by tier

Hot leads go to HubSpot or the CRM stub, then the disabled Slack node.

Warm leads are logged for review and are not pushed to the CRM.

Cold leads are logged only.

To notify on hot leads, enable Slack or replace it with an email node.

## Errors

Claude HTTP failures answer the webhook with 502. Invalid JSON answers 422. Bad input answers 400.

The last 50 error notes sit in this workflow's static data under `errorLog`.

Also import `workflows/error-handler.json` and select it as the error workflow in the workflow settings. That catches a crash this branch does not handle.
